Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSafehouseV: Allows players to toggle a blue ground overlay showing their safehouse area.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnhancedInvites_: Allows inviting players even if they already own or belong to another safehouse. Also lets a player who is only a member/sub-owner elsewhere claim their own safehouse (vanilla claim or Custom Claim) without being blocked by that membership.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxJoinedSafehou: Maximum number of safehouses a player can join with Enhanced invites ON. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSafehouseMemb: Maximum number of players (owner + members) a single safehouse can have. 0 = unlimited (vanilla behavior).
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MultipleSafehous: When disabled (default), the normal system applies: a player can own at most one safehouse. When enabled, players can own more than one, up to 'Max safehouses per player' below - this applies both to Custom Claim and to the vanilla 'Claim Safehouse' action.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSafehousesPer: Maximum number of safehouses a player can OWN at the same time (safehouses where they're only a member don't count) when 'Enable owning multiple safehouses' is on. 0 = unlimited. Has no effect otherwise.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_SingleRespawnSaf: When a player enables respawn in one safehouse, Better Safehouse removes that player from the respawn list of all other safehouses.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_AdminsFreeAddToS: Allows admins to add any player to a safehouse via the UI, without restrictions.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimEnabl: Enables custom claim BY ITEM. Incompatible with 'Custom claim anywhere (no item)'. Enable only one mode.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimFreeA: Allows custom claim WITHOUT an item anywhere. Choose a single preset, 'Custom (sandbox)', or 'All' to unlock 15x15, 30x30, 60x60 and Custom. Incompatible with item mode (enable only one).
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomSafehouseS: Used when 'Custom Safehouse (sandbox)' is selected in free mode, and for the CUSTOM option in item mode (if enabled).
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimItemC: In item mode, add CUSTOM size option

Only works when item-based custom claims are enabled and 'Custom claim anywhere (no item)' is disabled. Adds the CUSTOM option using the size defined in Sandbox and requires the 'customsafehouse' item.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_CustomClaimRestr: Restrict custom claim locations (buildings, roads, safehouses)
If enabled, blocks claiming inside existing safehouses, on roads/streets (tiles starting with 'blends_street') and nearby (distance set below).
Used only when location restriction is enabled. Blocks claims within this many tiles of roads/streets and existing safehouses.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_PhunZones2NoSafe: Block safehouse inside PhunZones 2 no-safehouse zones (works only if PhunZones 2 is active)
Only works when the PhunZones 2 mod is active. If PhunZones 2 is not loaded, this option has no effect whether enabled or disabled.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_VanillaSafehouse: If disabled, the 'Claim Safehouse' option will be blocked for all players. Use Custom Claim instead.
Maximum building area (W*H tiles) allowed for vanilla safehouse claim. 0 = no limit.
Minimum building area required for vanilla safehouse claim. 0 = no minimum.
Minutes a player must wait before claiming a new vanilla safehouse. 0 = no cooldown.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_AdminsCanRelease: Maximum admin powers: release any safehouse
Allows admins to remove/release a safehouse without changing its owner first.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleSys: Enables the role/tier-based expansion system for players whose role is listed in 'VIP/role names'. The base user expansion is always available and does not depend on this option.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionEnabled: Enables or disables the Better Safehouse expansion module.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlockRo: When enabled, blocks expanding the safehouse onto asphalt/road tiles (broad detection: covers all 7 in-game road textures plus common name patterns). Warning: the game reuses the same asphalt tiles for both real roads and driveways/garage entrances with no way to tell them apart, so this will also block expanding onto driveways, not just real roads.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionRoleMax: Extra-tile limit above the original safehouse for supporter/roles.
Hard cap for the final safehouse area after role-based expansion (W*H tiles). 0 = no total size cap.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax: Hard cap for the final safehouse area after user expansion (W*H tiles), simple or advanced mode. 0 = no total size cap.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserBor: Simple system: only allows expanding the safehouse's border, if enabled. Only takes effect if the advanced system below is disabled. If both are disabled, user cannot expand the safehouse at all.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserAdv: Advanced system: allows expanding up to the defined limit, in any direction, from the in-game menu (same as role-based expansion, using the 'User step' and 'Max extra area (user)' limits below). If both systems (simple and advanced) are enabled at the same time, advanced takes priority.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax: Max extra area for user (advanced mode)
Extra-tile limit above the original safehouse for user, when advanced mode is enabled. Has no effect otherwise.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionBlocked: Extra road/street floor sprites to block, on top of the mod's built-in list (which already covers the vanilla road tileset). Comma-separated. Only used when Block roads is enabled.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionAllowed: Roles that can freely expand and shrink. These roles are configured in your server's admin panel (PZ's role/permission system) - here you just enter the exact name(s), comma-separated. Example: VIP,Supporter. The user role is ignored here.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_ExpansionUserMax: How many tiles user can push outward on each border from the original safehouse. Example: 1 turns 10x10 into 12x12.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_EnableSubOwners_: The safehouse owner can promote members to Sub-owner. Sub-owners can add and remove regular members, but cannot remove the owner, remove other sub-owners, change the owner or release the safehouse.
Sandbox_BetterSafehouse_MaxSubOwners_too: Maximum number of Sub-owners each safehouse can have. 0 = unlimited.
